ausgestellt.description: issue time, read after the grammar of format spec 10.7

erster_tag.description: start of the log; equal in every version

fuellerbindung.description: as in protocol_key_list; once set, equal in every later version of both formats

hybrid_ab.description: from this day on the verifier requires for every day entry in addition an ML-DSA-87 signature that counts (format spec 7.4.10, L2 (g')); at least erster_tag; not null only if the list names at least one key with alg ml-dsa-87; once set, equal in every later version /2 (content rules: a violation makes the list ineffective); when first set it lies after the day of ausgestellt of that version (vendor duty, heartbeat spec 9.11 item 10)

log_uri.description: absolute URI after RFC 3986 (scheme, then ':', then the rest), 1 to 512 characters (so that every COSE object in storage form fits into 1024 bytes, format spec 7.7.2) from [!-~], without a fragment ('#'); equal in every later version /2; not in the projection /1; COSE objects of this log carry it as iss in the CWT claims (label 15), because RFC 9943 requires a URI for iss; the verifier checks only this grammar and the equality rule (step L1), the signing procedure checks the rest of RFC 3986 (heartbeat spec 9.11 item 10)

orte.description: places of publication; at least one outside the vendor's operation; they change only with a new version signed by the vendor root; what a reader can expect from a place outside the vendor's operation and how to check it: heartbeat spec 9.9

schluessel.description: per key exactly these members; a key_id and a pubkey (compared as strings) occur at most once each; at least one key with alg ed25519 (content rule)

alg.description: known: ed25519 (pubkey hex64), ml-dsa-87 (pubkey mldsa87_pub); any other alg establishes nothing, counts for uniqueness and gives unknown_alg in the report

pubkey.description: grammar: 1 to 8192 characters from [!-~]; content rule: hex64 with alg ed25519, mldsa87_pub (B64, 3456 characters, 2592 bytes) with alg ml-dsa-87; a pubkey that does not fit its known alg makes the list ineffective

version.description: strictly increasing; counted together with the lists /1 of the same log: for every version of a list /2 the list /1 of the same version is its projection
